description: The AI content strategist of the page (DeepSeek in thinking mode: deepseek-flash in chats, deepseek-v4-pro otherwise). Instructions = the strategy, the manager's goals, its playbook of learned lessons and its recent work log; it acts only through 'Content agent: tools'. Runs when the manager writes in Lark (answer sent back), when something happens (an approval or rejection), in a daily shift at 02:00 (plans, drafts, asks) and in a weekly review on Monday 03:00 (reads every signal, updates its playbook, reports to the manager). Every run is saved to content_agent.events as its work log.
name: Content agent

parameters.description: Propose one offer; it is checked against the strategy (two a month, a simple deal, a reason, dates) and sent to your manager for approval. offer is a JSON object: {"title", "product" (as written in the brand docs), "offer_type": "percent_off|amount_off|free_extra|buy_one_get_one|bundle", "offer" (the deal in one line), "reason_type": "calendar_date|milestone|limited_capacity|playful", "reason", "launch_date", "reminder_date" (2 to 4 days after launch), "ends_on" (0 to 3 days after the reminder), "landing_url" (only a link from the brand docs, else ""), "must_know": [3 to 5 lines], "must_feel": [2 to 3 lines], "rationale"}. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD.

value.offer: ={{ $fromAI('offer', 'The offer as a JSON object in the shape given in the tool description', 'string') }}

parameters.description: Plan posts for free days. Each one is checked: one post a day, sales posts only on the launch or reminder date of an approved offer, every other post leads to the next approved offer, no selling outside sales posts. Returns the created ids and the refused entries with reasons. posts is a JSON array: [{"date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "time": "HH:MM" (inside the posting window), "kind": "education|story|offer_launch|offer_reminder", "offer_id": 1, "title", "brief" (what the post says, concrete enough to write from), "hook_type": "question|contrarian|story|number|how_to|mistake|confession|observation|other", "angle", "hypothesis" (what it tests and what you expect), "image_brief" (the picture you want, or "" for a text post)}].

parameters.description: Goal progress, post results by kind/hook/weekday, approvals, rejections, change requests, what your manager said, audience comments, offer results, playbook changes, and unreviewed signals.

Your playbook: short lessons and long guidelines. Without id it adds an entry; with id it revises that entry, retires it (status retired), or restores a guideline's text from before its last revision (status previous). Needs evidence. A lesson is one sentence; a guideline is a long document with a title, and a revision sends its full new text with change. Entries from your manager (source manager) are added only while talking with them.
